model_annotation:
The diagram shows an index over time from 2016 to 2024 for three categories: overall economic policy, fiscal policy, and trade policy. The x-axis represents time in yearly intervals from 2016 to 2024. The y-axis on the left side represents an index from 0 to 1000. The y-axis on the right side represents an index from 0 to 9000. 

The black line represents overall economic policy. It begins at approximately 50 in 2016 and fluctuates up and down to around 100 in 2018. It then decreases to approximately 25 in 2020, increases sharply to about 475 in early 2022, decreases to approximately 100 in late 2022, and then increases to around 8000 in 2024. 

The blue line represents fiscal policy. It begins at approximately 100 in 2016, fluctuates up and down to around 200 in 2018, decreases to approximately 25 in 2020, increases sharply to about 700 in early 2022, decreases to approximately 100 in late 2022, and then increases to around 7500 in 2024. 

The purple line represents trade policy. It begins at approximately 25 in 2016, fluctuates up and down to around 50 in 2018, decreases to approximately 10 in 2020, increases slightly to about 50 in 2022, and then increases to around 7500 in 2024.
